Voice assistant

Browser support required

Use speech recognition if your browser and language settings support it. Spoken results are placed in the box below for you to review.

VIVASAYI VOICEFarm CompanionReady when you areTap the orb to begin voice input. If permission is blocked, open microphone help below. This demo is not connected to a live AI response service.

Ready. Tap “Enable microphone” first, then “Start speaking”.

Microphone not working? Show fixes
  1. Open this page in Chrome using its HTTPS website address, or on localhost. Opening an HTML attachment, file preview or in-app browser can block speech recognition.
  2. When Chrome asks, choose Allow for microphone access.
  3. If you already blocked it, tap the site controls near the address bar → Permissions / Site settings → Microphone → Allow, then reload the page.
  4. On Android, also check Settings → Apps → Chrome → Permissions → Microphone → Allow only while using the app.
  5. Connect to the internet for browser speech recognition. If speech recognition is not supported, tap the text box and use the microphone on your phone keyboard (for example, Gboard voice typing).

Your browser may use an online speech service. Spoken text is placed in the box for you to review; this demo is not connected to a live AI assistant.

Vivasayi on a Basic Phone 📟

Designed for farmers using keypad phones or with limited internet. Get important farm information through simple SMS-style commands and community assistance.

🌾
Prototype note: This page demonstrates the service and message formats. Real SMS, USSD or voice calls need a telecom/SMS gateway and a server; this standalone HTML page cannot send messages or receive replies yet.

📨 SMS command guide

Keypad friendly

A proposed service could let a farmer text one short keyword to a local service number.

Text messageInformation returned
MARKETToday’s crop prices and nearby market names
WEATHERRain forecast and basic weather alerts
CROP PADDYBasic paddy growing tips
SCHEMEGovernment scheme information and where to ask
HELPMenu of available commands and support options

These are proposed commands, not a live SMS number. No SMS will be sent from this demo.

☎️ Try the simple menu

Demo

Choose what you would ask for using a basic phone.

Welcome to Vivasayi Connect. Reply 2 for market, 3 for weather, 4 for crop advice, 5 for schemes, or 0 for help.

🤝 Help through a local contact

Farmers without internet access could also get help through a participating village service centre, farmer group, or agriculture extension worker.

  • Ask for market prices before taking produce to market.
  • Request help reading scheme eligibility and application steps.
  • Ask a trusted helper to read weather or crop advice aloud.

Local phone numbers and service-centre details can be added when verified contacts are available.

🗣️ Keep it accessible

  • Short messages with simple words.
  • Tamil-first messages, with English as an option.
  • No app installation or smartphone required for the planned SMS service.
  • Voice-call/IVR support can be added in a later phase.

The current website still needs a browser-capable device; this page outlines the future feature for keypad-phone users.
